name: Dat Mui
kicker: Southern tip where the two seas meet
summary: Stand at the sail and GPS0001, mangrove and both seas in view, on a road day from the city. The gate runs 07:00–18:00 and the ticket is 15,000–30,000 VND. You can stay at one spot for as long as the gate is open. Leave the city in the morning so you are inside before it shuts.
getThere: South through Năm Căn. 58.7 km from cầu Ông Tình.
heroCaption: The cape from above: mangrove, the boardwalk, and the sea

notice.title: Leave the city in the morning
notice.body: The gate is open 07:00–18:00. A start after lunch can reach Đất Mũi after it shuts.

body: The sail carries the words Mũi Cà Mau and the coordinates 8°37′30″ N, 104°43′ E. It went into service at the end of 2020. Beside it are the national marker GPS0001, the end of the Hồ Chí Minh road, the sea wall, and Cột cờ Hà Nội. From the tip you look at the place where the East Sea and the West Sea meet.

Work on the road-end marker started on 15 February 2017, at an investment of about 70 billion đồng. The mangrove and the mudflats are the same visit as the marker. Give the gate a morning start from the city.

The address is ấp Mũi, xã Đất Mũi. Sleep in the city, or stay near the gate when you want the dawn inside it. Motorbikes use the road south of Năm Căn. The expressway ends at xã Hồ Thị Kỷ, and motorbikes stay off it.

figures.caption: The sail marked Mũi Cà Mau, with mangrove behind it
figures.alt: White sail monument reading Mũi Cà Mau, with a red flag, steps, and mangrove trees

gettingThere: Ride south from the city through Năm Căn. The Hồ Chí Minh section from cầu Ông Tình to the gate is 58.7 km. The 58.7 km starts at cầu Ông Tình in Năm Căn.

legs.heading: From Ca Mau
legs.body: By road through Năm Căn, then the Hồ Chí Minh road. Motorbikes can use this road. They stay off the expressway, which ends at xã Hồ Thị Kỷ.

legs.heading: From Năm Căn
legs.body: 58.7 km on the Hồ Chí Minh road from cầu Ông Tình to the gate.

closed: The gate is a daytime gate.
admissionNote: 15,000–30,000 VND. Confirm which band you pay at the gate. A cart or a canoe is extra.
